name: appium-wincore-dotnet-bridge
description: In-process .NET (WinForms / WPF / DevExpress) UI-tree bridge for appium-wincore-driver, as an installable Appium plugin

scripts.build:plugin: dotnet publish csharp/WincoreDotnetBridge/WincoreDotnetBridge.csproj -c Release -o native/plugin/ && node scripts/assemble-native.js
scripts.build:agent-core: dotnet publish dotnet-bridge-agent-core/BridgeAgentCore.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 -o native/plugin/ --self-contained false && dotnet publish dotnet-bridge-agent-core/BridgeAgentCore.csproj -c Release -r win-x86 -o native/plugin/win-x86/ --self-contained false
scripts.build:all: npm run build:agent && npm run build:profiler && npm run build:agent-core && npm run build:x86-stub && npm run build:plugin && npm run build

author: Automate The Planet
